Psychiatry / psychology papers support the tested hypothesis 90% of the
time.  This is the highest rate of any branch of science, as reviewed
here:\
\
<http://journals.plos.org/plosone/article?id=10.1371/journal.pone.0010068>\
\
This could mean one or more of the following:\
\
\* Psychology theories are excellent predictors of interesting results;\
\* Psychology papers do not test interesting / unlikely predictions;\
\* Psychology papers adapt the hypothesis to the data or the other way
round.
